specName: Per-keyboard decision audit (CYOA Phase 1 — record and review)
approach: Record every survey answer and every editor-step net effect as an append-only per-keyboard decision record, hung off applyStepCompletion via an injected dep so no step component learns about auditing. Impact is a line diff over the emitted .kmn text that projectWorkingCopyVfs already produces for the live preview, so the audit and the shipped artifact cannot disagree. Evidence ships via a bounded PR-body block plus a studio-metadata sidecar that the existing isSidecarPath/isSourceFile filter keeps out of the committed tree.

decisions.decision: Capture a decision impact from projectWorkingCopyVfs, the shared projection the live OSK preview already runs every cycle, and store the net line diff
decisions.why: FR-009/SC-005 require the attributed change to come from the same process that produces the shipped keyboard; that helper is the single one both the preview and the zip/PR paths delegate to, so snapshotting is a read of an existing computation rather than a new pipeline
decisions.rejected: Emitting directly from the working IR with the codec emitter - not byte-equal to the shipped .kmn because projection additionally applies touch layout, carve keycaps, assignments and the identity overlay, so it would violate SC-005 by construction

decisions.decision: Survey-decision counterfactuals ride the existing mutate() seam and report the FR-011 reason when it is off; direct per-step capture applies to every step as the floor
decisions.why: The mutate seam is the declared write path, so re-running a pure mutate() is the same process in FR-009 sense - but mutateFlag.ts documents it as off by default and roughly half-complete, so in a default build most survey counterfactuals are genuinely unavailable and must say so
decisions.rejected: Making counterfactual derivation the only impact source for survey answers - with the seam off it would leave most entries showing nothing, which the spec Edge Cases forbid; and building a second audit-only re-derivation path would be a competing write path

decisions.decision: Packaged record reuses the existing zip-included / PR-excluded sidecar lifecycle at a studio-metadata prefix (.studio/decision-record.json); positional nesting of the keyboard under <id>/ is deferred to the Keyman team
decisions.why: FR-019/SC-008 concern the committed tree and isSidecarPath + isSourceFile already make that exclusion machine-enforced. FR-020 beside-not-inside cannot be satisfied positionally today - the archive root IS the keyboard directory content and NEXT_STEPS.md already sits there with the same property
decisions.rejected: Restructuring the archive so the keyboard nests under <id>/ - deferred not rejected; it makes the separation structural and fixes the NEXT_STEPS wart, but changes an already-shipped artifact shape and is a Keyman-team-facing call

decisions.decision: Provenance carries an agency literal (base-derived | tool-proposed | hand-set) plus an optional separate source label; SurveyAnswer is not extended
decisions.why: Two of the three agency literals are reused verbatim from TouchKeyProvenance and the source labels are lifted from specs/002-defaults-engine, so no new vocabulary is invented for either axis; keeping agency and source separate is what lets a headline distinguish Accepted suggested X from langtags versus Chose X
decisions.rejected: Extending the locked SurveyAnswer union with a provenance field, and reusing TouchKeyProvenance directly - its physical-suggested member is touch-propagation-specific and overloading it would make the touch semantics ambiguous

plan.summary: Plan complete: plan.md (Constitution Check green across Articles I-VIII), research.md (12 decisions), data-model.md, and two contracts - decision-record and trail-ui
plan.key_finding: Two load-bearing codebase facts shaped the design: projectWorkingCopyVfs is the single projection both the live preview and the zip/PR paths delegate to (so impact capture is a read of a computation that already runs, satisfying SC-005 by construction), and specs/032-journey-corpus is unimplemented, making this feature the first implementer of its two-event vocabulary

tasks.summary: 50 tasks across 6 phases (Setup 1, Foundational 19, US1 12, US2 7, US3 6, Polish 5), laid out as explicit waves with join points; all 28 functional requirements mapped to covering tasks
tasks.key_finding: Recording plumbing (store, persistence, reducer injection, the three recording modules) lands in Foundational rather than US1, which makes US2 and US3 depend only on the record existing and not on the trail UI - so each story is a genuinely independent increment. The single cross-story dependency is T045 reusing impact.ts from T023.

implement.summary: Delivered Phase 1 (Setup) + Phase 2 (Foundational) + US1 (T001-T032): the contracts types with their zod mirror and drift guards, the engine differ/serializer/tolerant-reader/shed pass, the append-only decision log with persistence, the three recorders wired through an injected ReducerDeps callback, and the author-facing trail on a production route.
implement.key_finding: Two design points had to depart from the plan text to satisfy the FRs. (1) D-02/T018 puts recording on applyStepCompletion, but StepHost gates that on a six-step effect table and choose_base fires it from an async callback - hanging the audit there would silently miss every question step, i.e. most of FR-001. Recording therefore got its own reducer-layer entry point (recordStepCompletion) called unconditionally from the host completion path; D-02 requirements are intact (injected dep, no component learns about auditing). (2) Impact capture is async because the output projection is, so the log gained one narrow write-once attachImpact rather than a strictly-immutable entry; the decision fields stay frozen. Also stated plainly: no per-question proposal register exists in the studio today (IdentityLite keeps its langtags seeds in a component ref), so provenance derivation is a tested seam whose shipped wiring records hand-set for most answers.

FR-001.title: Record every survey answer as an individual decision entry with its provenance

FR-002.title: Record editor activity aggregated per step; a return visit supersedes the step's earlier entry

FR-003.title: The decision record MUST be append-only; revisiting adds a superseding entry

FR-004.title: Record decisions from session start including pre-identity work, carried forward on identity assignment

FR-005.title: The decision record MUST persist across studio restarts as part of saved state

FR-006.title: Recording MUST NOT alter the keyboard artifact

FR-007.title: Event vocabulary MUST align with specs/032-journey-corpus and not fork it

FR-008.title: Produce the concrete source change attributable to each decision

FR-009.title: The attributed change MUST derive from the same process that produces the shipped keyboard

FR-010.title: Impact computed only when requested for a specific decision, never eagerly

FR-011.title: Where isolated impact cannot be derived, report a summary plus the reason, never a misleading empty change

FR-012.title: Authors MUST be able to view an ordered trail of their decisions

FR-013.title: Each entry shows a plain-language headline distinguishing accepted default from author-set value

FR-014.title: Each entry MUST be expandable to reveal its attributed source change

FR-015.title: Superseded entries remain visible as history and are clearly marked as replaced

FR-016.title: All author-facing text MUST be localisable under the existing message-catalogue conventions

FR-017.title: The trail MUST be available in production builds

FR-018.title: Render a human-readable decision summary into the pull-request description

FR-019.title: MUST NOT add any file to the committed keyboard source tree

FR-020.title: The downloadable package MUST contain a machine-readable record as a clearly-named studio-metadata sidecar

FR-021.title: The machine-readable record MUST use the completed-instance format extended for editor activity

FR-022.title: The pull-request summary MUST be bounded, pointing to the package for full detail

FR-023.title: The flow map MUST highlight the path a selected keyboard took

FR-024.title: With no keyboard selected, the flow map behaves exactly as it does today

FR-025.title: The flow map and its overlay remain absent from production builds

FR-026.title: At a single inspected decision, produce on request the outcome a different answer would have produced

FR-027.title: MUST NOT compute outcomes for untaken branches other than the one explicitly requested

FR-028.title: Where an alternative cannot be derived, show structural information plus an explanation, not a failure
